scope: Home application count projection and section lifetime; Agreement pagination integrity. Existing layout, task/Agreement semantics and server schema unchanged.

reproducedBeforeFix.meaning: New focused tests ran against the previous implementation before the fix; invalid continuation could return a successful partial list.

changes: Home requests one ALL application page at limit 1 and uses its exact aggregate counts; no full application history or page traversal for Home.
Home read sections settle at 15s or focus/account/background retirement; successful optional resources retain their existing recovery behavior.
Home passes the section lifetime to Agreement pages and public opportunities. Abort-aware transports receive cancellation; late results cannot publish.
Agreement pagination requires boolean hasMore, usable continuation and advancing timestamp/UUID keysets, preserves PostgreSQL microseconds, rejects duplicates and refuses partial success.
The existing 20-page cap and all accepted-term, rating and ownership semantics remain. A single terminal legacy workspace projection retains its existing mapping compatibility.
The existing preview build now defaults to the current emulator QA target; explicit phone dispatch remains available.

fullJest.processReceipt: All suites and JSON success verified. Delayed-exit warning emitted; execution session was no longer available for a final exit-code receipt. No forceExit or forced termination used.

dev.method: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; real request claims and rpc_closure_api_guard; existing actors only; ROLLBACK.
dev.limits: Three existing actors have 1/0/0 applications and 1/1/0 Agreements. This proves deployed small-account parity and shapes, not large-account or HTTP/device performance. JSON text byte counts are not compressed wire bytes; the page envelope is larger on these small accounts. Large history/keyset cases use local tests.

native.observation: Both runs observed in_progress on this exact source. No successful build, artifact, install or device acceptance claimed.

remaining: Home still reads full task and Agreement projections for drafts, accepted appointments, counts and prompts. A dedicated aggregate requires parity proof before replacement.
Core Home sections still join through Promise.all; this change does not deliver progressive independent core rendering.
Only transports accepting the new signal are physically aborted. Other one-shot reads are logically retired; their existing transport timeout still applies.
Legacy rating enrichment retains its existing four-request/four-second pool; this change does not add cancellation to that fallback.
Nine previously retained static cleanup candidates need domain review; no automatic deletion.
Native installation, on-device latency and physical-phone verification remain separate.
